shortDescription: US private equity firm Carlyle NASDAQ:CG and the EBRD have agreed to sell Romanian energy company Black Sea Oil & Gas to Dutch firm Mazarine, Carlyle said on Thursday, without disclosing the sum.

children: and the EBRD have agreed to sell Romanian energy company Black Sea Oil & Gas to Dutch firm Mazarine, Carlyle said on Thursday, without disclosing the sum.
Carlyle created Black Sea Oil & Gas in 2015 and brought in the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development with a 10% stake two years later
Under their ownership, BSOG brought the $400 million Midia gas project in the Black Sea into production as operator and majority shareholder in the asset
Midia produces 107 million cubic feet a day, or around 10% of Romania's demand, according to Carlyle
Mazarine, a previous Carlyle investment, operates oil and gas assets in Tunisia, Romania and the Netherlands
